purpose: Context-light agent rotation without transcript replay.
rules: Never paste large logs or raw file bodies into the handoff.
Store large payloads externally and pass stable paths/IDs/pointers.
New agents recover durable state first, then read only referenced evidence as needed.
Chat title is cosmetic; operational identity comes from role + durable packet.
A worker must not report DONE until the completion receipt exists and references a durable terminal result.
At terminal result the departing chat writes this packet, marks itself logically retired, and prints the next one-line activation command.
User status/check-in requests are observational and must not pause, reset, de-arm, or strand authorized work.
After reporting status, the receiving/active agent immediately resumes or dispatches the existing next executable step unless an explicit stop condition exists.
Routing, protocol entry, or handoff creation alone does not count as execution; a ready packet must begin useful work or record a concrete blocker.
While Office is OPEN, terminal work checkpoints, hands off, and automatically pulls the next safe objective.
Only explicit stop/hold/OFFLINE/CLOSED direction, a real blocker, required authorization/manual action, or unresolved policy decision may halt forward work.
A durable ready next_action must be dispatched/executed in the same continuation cycle when prerequisites pass; passive ready states must not wait for user check-ins.
Handoffs must carry accepted_partial_evidence and do_not_repeat guidance when available so successors narrow work to unresolved proof.
Recovery/routing/protocol-entry/indexing are prerequisites, not evidence-producing progress.
Terminal EXECUTE must transition to VERIFY; bounded VERIFY classification must transition to repair/EXECUTE automatically within repair budget.
Front/Coder/Analyzer are logical phases of one operational controller chat; status artifacts are receipts, not independent workers or reasons to wait.
